preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The maximum number of operations k is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The positive integer x is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The length of the array a is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the array a is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(bi % x == ai % x for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
postconditions.description: Each element bi in the output array b is congruent to the corresponding element ai in the input array a modulo x.
The length of the output array b is exactly n.
The product of all elements in the output array b is the minimum possible product achievable with no more than k operations.
